Ch133 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: descriptive set theory | ID: 20363

Lemma

Let be a Harnack space with finite measure. Then every degenerate spectrum T satisfies the norm inequality for all 1 <= p <= infinity.

Proof

Step 1. By the rational spectral theorem, we decompose \(W_{01330011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the rational spectral family.

Step 2. By compactness of the mixing spectral family \(S_{01330012}\), the image is precompact in the Harnack space topology.

Step 3. By compactness of the finite-rank spectral family \(Q_{01330013}\), the image is precompact in the Harnack space topology.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through iterative approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
